messages:
lia: quick flag 1:10 UTC: after the KMS rekey + yesterday's firewall tighten, we're seeing sporadic keystore denies and a correlated spike in audit logs. GPU onboarding latency up, some nodes stuck in init. sample from cluster logs:
```
2026-03-20T21:09:43Z init WARN keystore request denied: AccessDeniedException KMS:Decrypt
2026-03-20T21:09:44Z warmup ERROR join failed: keystore decrypt timeout
```

sanjay: same. Affecting us-east-1 and eu-west-1 warm pools. Not user traffic but capacity runway is shrinking. Looks like privatelink egress rules are too narrow for ephemeral ENIs used by keystore clients.

maya: auditshipper metrics: S3 PUTs jumped 6x during the rotation window, then our log exporter retried (5xx) -> repeated PUTs. Could blow monthly S3 cost if this goes >1hr.

dmitri: root cause triage so far: 1) KMS rotation triggered re-issuance of session tokens 2) keystore proxy restarted and re-auths from ephemeral clients 3) firewall allowlist only included stable privatelink IPs, not ENIs created with tag keystore-client 4) IAM condition on keystore role uses sourceVpcEndpointId which breaks when clients use transient ENIs.

jen: Oof. We intentionally tightened egress for compliance. We need a way to allow keystore traffic with minimal expansion of the allowlist. Options: allow privatelink service name in SG, add ENI CIDR blocks (short TTL), or make IAM condition less strict. Thoughts?

ops-bot: ALERT: gpu-warmup-failure-rate > 5% for 10m. New nodes failing to reach RUNNING state.

lia: Proposal: 1) Temporarily patch SG to allow keystore-tagged ENI CIDR range (10.240.12.0/22) + restrict to dest port 443, TTL 60m 2) Flip auditshipper to 25% sample to stop PUT storm 3) Open infra PR to add a controlled exception for keystore privatelink endpoints and add revert gate. 4) Update KMS rotation runbook to include pre-populating privatelink allowlist.

sanjay: +1. Keep IAM change for last resort. We can't relax IAM quickly without sign-off. Prefer SG tweak scoped to tagged ENIs and short TTL. Also add a healthcheck probe that bypasses the audit exporter so keystore handshake doesn't increment S3.

maya: AWS CLI to add egress rule (scoped to SG):
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0f1a2b3c --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.240.12.0/22 --description "temp allow keystore ENIs"
```
I'll run this once PR to infra-change is approved.

dmitri: I'll draft the terraform change: add keystore-privatelink-exception with meta ttl=1h and doc link to this thread. Also adding a canary that attempts keystore decrypts before we rotate next key.

jen: Cost check: temporary warm nodes to cover failures are ~ $4k/day per region. Sampling reduces S3 cost by ~ $3k/day. Net ~ $1k/day per region if we scale. Keep the window minimal.

ops-bot: action: audit-sampler rolled to 25% (deploy id: ds-99877).

lia: 18m after SG change in staging: keystore decrypt latency back to normal (~120ms) and nodes join. Will monitor production for 1h. Please link PRs and postmortem checklist items to the rotation runbook.

sanjay: If anything regresses, we'll rollback the firewall only (not the rotation). Thanks all. :thumbsup:
